verdict.rationale: Unleash documents the core flow: a hosted instance ready without local setup, creating a first flag in the Admin UI, connecting an SDK, and enabling or disabling flags per environment, including production, without redeploying. The 'within minutes of signing up' part is not demonstrated, and one hands-on community report calls the UI more complex than needed. missing for 10: evidence of a minutes-scale signup-to-production-toggle path, independent hands-on corroboration of onboarding speed, explicit documentation of toggling a flag live in a production environment as part of the quickstart

support.subject: As a developer, I can create a feature flag and toggle it live in production within minutes of signing up

citations.quote: This gives you a ready-to-use instance, so you can explore all Unleash features without any local setup.
Create your first feature flag using the Unleash Admin UI.
use one of the client or backend SDKs to connect Unleash with your application
They allow you to enable and disable features for certain users without having to redeploy your application.
each environment has different feature flag configurations. This allows you to enable a flag in development or test without enabling it in production.
